title: How to Clean a TV Screen

seo.title: How to Clean a TV Screen
seo.meta_description: Clean a cool, powered-off TV screen with a soft microfiber cloth. Do not spray liquid directly or use glass cleaner, alcohol, or abrasives unless approved.
seo.search_intent: Remove dust and fingerprints from a television screen without damaging coatings, pushing liquid into the bezel, or leaving scratches.

excerpt: Modern displays have delicate surface coatings. For dust and fingerprints, less product is usually better: a clean microfiber cloth and only minimal approved moisture when needed.
content_html:
Turn the television off, unplug it if you will use any moisture, and let the panel cool. Never spray cleaner directly onto the screen.

Start dry

Use a clean soft microfiber cloth with no gritty particles trapped in it. Wipe with minimal pressure; several gentle passes are safer than pressing hard on a fingerprint.

If a mark remains, check the manual

Many manufacturers permit a cloth lightly dampened with distilled water or a specified screen solution. The cloth should be barely damp, never dripping.

Skip household glass cleaner unless specifically approved

Ammonia, alcohol, and other solvents can affect antireflective layers or surface finishes. Paper towels, abrasive pads, and scouring powders can also scratch.

Keep liquid away from the bezel and openings

Moisture can wick into the frame and electronics. If a drop runs toward an edge, dry it immediately and leave the set powered off.

Use a separate cloth for the frame and stand

The bezel may tolerate different cleaning than the display panel, but applying product to the cloth rather than the television is still the safer habit. Let everything dry before reconnecting power.

Screen cleaning rarely needs aggressive degreasing chemistry. Dust first, use very light pressure, and add only the moisture the manufacturer allows.

faq.question: Can I use window cleaner on a TV?
faq.answer: Not as a general rule. Many contain solvents that can damage display coatings.

faq.question: Can I spray water directly on the screen?
faq.answer: No. If moisture is allowed, lightly dampen the cloth instead.

faq.question: Are paper towels safe?
faq.answer: A clean soft microfiber cloth is preferred because it is less likely to scratch or leave lint.
